items.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
items.excerpt: According to the new terms, sharing your data for better AI recommendations also means opening it up for more personalized ads.

items.title: Meta delays its AI terms to November 20. The trust problem does not move
items.excerpt: Meta delayed its AI crawling terms to November 20 after publisher complaints, in a week Google let Gmail data shape ads and advertisers pulled AI-edited ads.

items.title: Meta's ads with creators gain 97% to a $15bn annual run rate
items.excerpt: Nearly 10 million advertisers used Meta's AI creative tools in Q3. Muse, set up by 10 million people, will charge businesses fees on sales. How will it work?

items.title: Meta case study credits Nest's AI ads with 20% higher conversion rates
items.excerpt: Seven UK brands put 68% of Meta spend into video, against a 38% benchmark. The page gives no period or baseline, so how much the AI tool added remains unclear.

items.title: Explore new ways to drive your best ROI with the first Google Marketing Platform Drop.
items.excerpt: Google Marketing Platform Drops, a new monthly series, delivers our latest news to help you get your best ROI across the full customer journey. We’ll cover everything fr…

items.title: Google Ads Asset Optimization Sourced Videos Toggle
items.excerpt: Google Ads has added a new "Sourced videos" on/off toggle setting to the asset optimization section.  This uses Google AI to identify relevant videos from your approved sources and add them to your campaign automatically.

items.title: Google Ads Translation Tool
items.excerpt: Google Ads is now rolling out the Translation tool within the advertiser console. This allows advertisers to "Translate your campaigns to reach global customers and boost your conversions," Google wrote.

items.title: Google Universal Cart In Search Is Live
items.excerpt: Last week, we reported that Google was launching its Universal Cart in the United States after demoing it at Google I/O in May.  And yes, a few days after Google announced it, it was rolling out. I think most people started to see it show up in Google Search and Gemini starting on Friday and over the weekend.

items.title: Target's holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
items.excerpt: Target is betting on daily deals and a digital assistant to woo budget-conscious shoppers this holiday season.

items.title: Q3: Omnicom’s Media Business Is Growing, But Is It Agent-Proof?
items.excerpt: If AI agents can plan and buy media, who needs a holding company? Good question. It came up during Omnicom's Q3 earnings on Thursday.

items.title: Meta Grows Revenue 26% Despite Massive Muse Operating Costs
items.excerpt: Despite spending billions in lawsuits and high Muse operating costs, Meta's third quarter earnings still showed significant growth.

items.title: Etsy updates AI use policies to emphasize craftsmanship
items.excerpt: While it’s implementing more AI, the online marketplace now requires at least one authentic, non-AI generated image in most seller listings.

items.title: Sociable: Meta adds users and revenue as AI costs climb
items.excerpt: Revenue rose 26% year over year in the third quarter to nearly $65 billion, but expenses were up 68% due to capital expenditures.

items.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
items.excerpt: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.
